articles.title_en: Public and private sector zero-deforestation commitments and their impacts: A case study from South Sumatra Province, Indonesia
articles.title_cn: 公共和私营部门的零毁林承诺及其影响：来自印度尼西亚南苏门答腊省的案例研究
articles.abstract_en: In Asia, Africa, and Latin America, complex drivers of deforestation have sparked mandatory and voluntary initiatives, including moratorium policies, zero-deforestation pledges and certification systems. The impacts of these different commitments, which aim to reduce deforestation, have yet to be documented or analytically scrutinized. Using South Sumatra as a case study, we used the Institutional Analysis and Development (IAD) framework to identify the context and impacts of public and private sector commitments. Public sector commitment was assessed by examining political will reflected in government policies and regulations, while private sector commitment was assessed by looking at compliance with mandatory and voluntary certification schemes. South Sumatra lost 63% of its natural forest between 1990 and 2019. Deforestation is driven by expansion of large-scale commercial plantations, as well as illegal logging and clearing. Our study indicates that public and private sector commitments do matter. Statistically, we found sufficient evidence that private sector commitments were able to significantly reduce deforestation from year of commitments to 2019, at a 90% confidence level. Efforts to support zero-deforestation commitments must involve radical shifts in current policy and practice, with stricter law enforcement to combat illegal activities, greater transparency to inform progress, and the development of strategic and actionable plans.
articles.abstract_cn: 在亚洲、非洲和拉丁美洲，毁林的复杂驱动因素引发了强制性和自愿性倡议，包括暂停政策、零毁林承诺和认证体系。这些旨在减少毁林的不同承诺的影响尚未被记录或分析审查。以南苏门答腊为案例，我们使用制度分析与发展（IAD）框架来识别公共和私营部门承诺的背景和影响。公共部门的承诺通过考察政府政策和法规中反映的政治意愿来评估，而私营部门的承诺则通过考察对强制性和自愿性认证计划的遵守情况来评估。南苏门答腊在1990年至2019年间失去了其天然林的63%。毁林是由大规模商业种植园的扩张以及非法采伐和清理所驱动的。我们的研究表明，公共和私营部门的承诺确实重要。统计上，我们发现了足够的证据表明，私营部门的承诺能够从承诺年份到2019年显著减少毁林，置信水平为90%。支持零毁林承诺的努力必须涉及当前政策和实践的根本性转变，包括加强执法以打击非法活动，提高透明度以告知进展，以及制定战略性和可操作的计划。

articles.title_en: Assessing national land administration reform in Mongolia: A mixed method evaluation using bank loan and historical land administration data
articles.title_cn: 评估蒙古国家土地管理改革：基于银行贷款和历史土地管理数据的混合方法评价
articles.abstract_en: This study presents the findings from a rigorous performance evaluation of a land registry strengthening project in Mongolia. The paper contributes to a small but growing body of systematic evaluations on land administration interventions—and particularly on efforts to build the national capacity of state agencies through institutional strengthening initiatives. The research highlights a methodological approach that utilizes mixed method data sources to explore outcomes in a more rigorous way and through a gendered lens. We rely on a unique set of primary quantitative data sources, including extensive land administration and bank loan data. In addition to ex- ploring outcomes associated with credit access and lending, our extensive data sources enable us to delve into transaction cost, efficiency, and volume. We complement the quantitative data with comprehensive qualitative data from interviews and focus group discussions. This study finds that the project improved Mongolia’s registration process and land administration system. There are notable increases in transaction efficiency; digitization and strengthening of information systems; and improved transparency and access to land records. In contrast, there is more limited evidence about the program’s effect on facilitating improvements in the accuracy of land records, land markets, access to credit, and gender equality in land rights. While the project helped to reduce some instances of corruption, there remain broad challenges to land governance reform.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究展示了对蒙古土地登记强化项目进行严格绩效评估的结果。本文为土地管理干预措施的系统性评估——特别是通过机构强化举措建设国家机构能力的努力——这一虽小但不断增长的研究领域做出了贡献。研究强调了一种利用混合方法数据来源，以更严格的方式并通过性别视角探索结果的方法论途径。我们依赖一组独特的初级定量数据来源，包括广泛土地管理和银行贷款数据。除了探索与信贷获取和贷款相关的结果外，我们广泛的数据来源使我们能够深入研究交易成本、效率和数量。我们用访谈和焦点小组讨论的全面定性数据补充定量数据。本研究发现，该项目改善了蒙古的登记流程和土地管理系统。交易效率显著提高；信息系统数字化和强化；土地记录的透明度和获取性得到改善。相比之下，关于该项目在促进土地记录准确性、土地市场、信贷获取和土地权利性别平等方面改善的证据较为有限。虽然该项目帮助减少了某些腐败现象，但土地治理改革仍面临广泛挑战。

articles.title_en: Examining forest transition and collective action in Nepal’s community forestry
articles.title_cn: 审视尼泊尔社区林业中的森林转型与集体行动
articles.abstract_en: Nepal is going through a major socio-economic transition in rural areas and hence in forest management practices, leading to changes in and evolution of new forest-people relationships. Community forests are experiencing an ecological transition resulting a new pattern of growth, regeneration and diversity in forest composition. The ecological transition of forest corresponds to the shifting local collective actions in community forestry which are emerging from the new socio-economic dynamics in rural areas such as income-diversification, declining subsistence utilization of forest resources and outmigration of the rural population. However, these changes are highly differentiated and variable. The hilly areas are experiencing remarkable forest cover changes than in the lowlands of Terai. In this paper, we examine the evolving intersection between new forest transition and community collective action in Nepal. We draw our analysis on the comparative case study of four villages from three different ecological regions. Our findings show that the forest transition is not static, but a dynamic process shaped by diverse local and external factors. Further, declining utilization of forests for subsistence uses has led to a new dynamic in community collective action which has played a central role in driving forest transition. Community participation in forest management is also declining. Hence, we call for reconceptualizing local collective action in this changed context which can help revise forest policies and reimagine forest institutions that can better respond to the socio-economic changes of the mountain landscape and revitalize local collective actions.
articles.abstract_cn: 尼泊尔农村地区正在经历重大的社会经济转型，森林管理实践也随之变化，导致森林与人类关系发生改变并演化出新的形态。社区森林正在经历生态转型，呈现出新的生长、更新和物种组成多样性模式。森林的生态转型与社区林业中正在变化的当地集体行动相对应，这些集体行动源于农村地区新的社会经济动态，如收入多样化、森林资源生计利用减少以及农村人口外迁。然而，这些变化具有高度差异性和可变性。丘陵地区的森林覆盖变化比德赖低地更为显著。本文考察了尼泊尔新的森林转型与社区集体行动之间不断演变的交集。我们基于三个不同生态区四个村庄的比较案例研究进行分析。我们的研究结果表明，森林转型并非静态，而是一个由多种地方和外部因素塑造的动态过程。此外，森林生计利用的减少导致了社区集体行动的新动态，这在推动森林转型中发挥了核心作用。社区对森林管理的参与也在减少。因此，我们呼吁在这一变化背景下重新概念化地方集体行动，这有助于修订森林政策并重新构想森林制度，以更好地应对山区景观的社会经济变化，并振兴地方集体行动。

articles.title_en: Facing post-crisis livelihood challenges? Insights from young farmers in Kenema city, Eastern Province, Sierra Leone
articles.title_cn: 面对危机后的生计挑战？来自塞拉利昂东部省凯内马市青年农民的观点
articles.abstract_en: Globally, urban and peri-urban agriculture (UPA) research has focused mainly on capital cities, has avoided conflict-affected locations and rarely considered the challenges faced by young cultivators. The latter are particularly important because of the vulnerability of unemployed young people to being drawn into violent, criminal or antisocial behaviour in conflict or fragile states. This paper examines the post-crisis livelihood challenges of youth farmers in Kenema, Sierra Leone’s third largest city. The research on which this paper is based comprised multiple methods, including GIS mapping, in-depth interviews and group discussions with youth cultivators and key informants in several sites in Kenema city. Research participants gave first-hand accounts of their experiences of the Civil War and the subsequent Ebola epidemic crisis, and the paper explores their transformation from dangerous living to productive agriculturalists within Kenema. The research uses an exploratory approach to critically examine the engagement of youth in urban and peri-urban agriculture, as a strategy for encouraging young people to become responsible citizens who support city and national development. The paper challenges the pessimistic view that contemporary urban youth in developing countries are characterised by disaffection leading to crime. The study reveals how urban youth in post-crisis contexts can play a vital role in national development when a proactive and pro-youth public platform is evident locally. Appropriate resource mobilisation can unlock the latent potentials of youth for both self and community development.
articles.abstract_cn: 在全球范围内，城市和城郊农业（UPA）研究主要集中在首都城市，回避了受冲突影响的地区，并且很少考虑年轻耕种者面临的挑战。后者尤为重要，因为在冲突或脆弱国家中，失业年轻人容易卷入暴力、犯罪或反社会行为。本文考察了塞拉利昂第三大城市凯内马青年农民在危机后的生计挑战。本文所依据的研究采用了多种方法，包括GIS制图、深度访谈以及与青年耕种者和关键信息提供者在凯内马市多个地点的小组讨论。研究参与者提供了他们内战和随后埃博拉疫情危机经历的第一手资料，本文探讨了他们从危险生活转变为凯内马市内生产性农民的过程。研究采用探索性方法，批判性地审视青年参与城市和城郊农业，作为鼓励年轻人成为支持城市和国家发展的负责任公民的策略。本文挑战了悲观的看法，即发展中国家当代城市青年以不满情绪导致犯罪为特征。研究揭示了在危机后背景下，当地方存在积极且支持青年的公共平台时，城市青年如何能在国家发展中发挥重要作用。适当的资源调动可以释放青年在自我和社区发展方面的潜在能力。

articles.title_en: COVID-19 in Sub-Saharan Africa: Impacts on land, governance, and livelihoods
articles.title_cn: 撒哈拉以南非洲的COVID-19：对土地、治理和生计的影响
articles.abstract_en: This paper focuses on the impacts of COVID-19 on livelihoods, land access and governance in rural and peri-urban selected areas of Sub-Saharan Africa. Crises are usually expected to be worse for citizens in developing countries since most of their economic activities are in the informal sector, and access to the social protection programs is often limited and exclusionary. Those vulnerable and marginalized are often those who are hit the hardest and who struggle the most to recover after crises. The COVID-19 pandemic is no exception. Extended lockdowns have put livelihoods under stress, underlying patterns of fragile livelihoods and inequality. There are also particular vulnerabilities with regards to land access and livelihoods of vulnerable populations. Our case studies document how the pandemic has affected livelihoods through several mechanisms relating to land access, including distress sales due to economic hardships and exacerbating land conflicts due to increased pressure on land and increasing trends of urban-to-rural migration. We reflect on how households act and react when faced with shocks and how this affects not only their current access to livelihood assets but might undermine their options for the future. In addition, a range of other effects were identified in our case studies that we expect to negatively impact livelihood recovery.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文关注COVID-19对撒哈拉以南非洲选定农村和城乡结合部地区的生计、土地获取和治理的影响。危机通常预期对发展中国家的公民更为严重，因为他们的大部分经济活动属于非正规部门，且社会保护项目的获取往往有限且具有排斥性。那些脆弱和边缘化的群体往往受冲击最严重，且在危机后恢复最为艰难。COVID-19大流行也不例外。长期封锁给生计带来压力，凸显了脆弱生计和不平等的模式。在土地获取和脆弱人群的生计方面也存在特定的脆弱性。我们的案例研究记录了疫情如何通过与土地获取相关的多种机制影响生计，包括因经济困难导致的困境出售，以及因土地压力增加和城乡迁移趋势上升而加剧的土地冲突。我们反思了家庭在面对冲击时的行为和反应，以及这如何不仅影响他们当前对生计资产的获取，还可能削弱他们未来的选择。此外，我们的案例研究还发现了其他一系列预计会对生计恢复产生负面影响的效应。

articles.title_en: Property size and forest cover were key determinants of forest restoration in Southern Bahia in the Atlantic Forest of Brazil
articles.title_cn: 地产规模和森林覆盖率是巴西大西洋森林南巴伊亚州森林恢复的关键决定因素
articles.abstract_en: Forest restoration has gained traction as a solution to mitigate climate change, contribute to biodiversity conservation, and support forest livelihoods. Yet there is limited evidence on the spatial locations where restoration is most likely to occur. In landscapes that primarily contain private properties, assessing the likelihood of restoration can be informed by understanding the enabling and limiting factors that have influenced property-level restoration in the past. In this paper, we tested the relationships between restoration, property size, and forest cover, for 8451 properties between 1985 and 2019 in Southern Bahia, Atlantic Forest, Brazil. We found that spatial property-level variables were strongly associated with restoration. First, we found that property size was positively correlated with the amount of restoration per property. Medium-sized properties (between 40 and 127 ha) accounted for the most restoration in aggregate. Second, we found that properties with less forest cover were associated with higher amounts of restoration. In addition, for properties larger than 20 ha, those with intermediate amounts of forest cover had high amounts of restoration. Third, we found that restoration was a spatial process that occurred in hotspots rather than randomly across the study landscape, indicating that restoration often occurred near to other restored properties. Understanding these relationships may assist restoration planners in making more informed estimates of the conditions that might enable future restoration. Given that restoration is a complex process that may require different approaches in different socio-environmental contexts, decision-makers may consider identifying and prioritizing properties of different sizes and with different amounts of forest cover depending on their specific priorities, landscape-level conditions, and restoration context. Our spatial analysis techniques assist in improving broader understanding of possible ways in which land use policy could prioritize for restoration at the property level and could later be applied to other socio-environmental tropical forest systems.
articles.abstract_cn: 森林恢复作为缓解气候变化、促进生物多样性保护和支持森林生计的解决方案已获得越来越多的关注。然而，关于恢复最可能发生的空间位置的证据有限。在主要包含私人地产的景观中，评估恢复的可能性可以通过理解过去影响地产层面恢复的促进和限制因素来提供信息。在本文中，我们测试了巴西大西洋森林南巴伊亚州1985年至2019年间8451个地产的恢复、地产规模和森林覆盖率之间的关系。我们发现，空间地产层面的变量与恢复密切相关。首先，我们发现地产规模与每个地产的恢复量呈正相关。中等规模的地产（40至127公顷）在总体上贡献了最多的恢复量。其次，我们发现森林覆盖率较低的地产与较高的恢复量相关。此外，对于大于20公顷的地产，那些具有中等森林覆盖率的地产具有较高的恢复量。第三，我们发现恢复是一个空间过程，发生在热点区域，而不是在研究景观中随机发生，这表明恢复通常发生在其他已恢复地产附近。理解这些关系可能有助于恢复规划者更明智地估计可能促进未来恢复的条件。鉴于恢复是一个复杂的过程，可能需要在不同的社会-环境背景下采取不同的方法，决策者可以考虑根据其具体优先事项、景观层面条件和恢复背景，识别并优先考虑不同规模和不同森林覆盖率的地产。我们的空间分析技术有助于提高对土地利用政策可能在地产层面优先考虑恢复的潜在方式的理解，并可能随后应用于其他社会-环境热带森林系统。

articles.title_en: Alternative systems and strategies to improve future sustainability and resilience of farming systems across Europe: from adaptation to transformation
articles.title_cn: 替代系统与策略：提升欧洲农业系统未来可持续性与韧性的路径——从适应到转型
articles.abstract_en: According to stakeholders, many European farming systems are close to critical thresholds regarding the challenges they face (e.g., droughts, price declines), functions they deliver (e.g., economic viability, biodiversity and habitat) and attributes required for resilience (e.g., social self-organization). To accelerate a transition process towards sustainable and resilient agriculture, this study aimed to identify actor-supported alternative systems across 10 European farming systems, and to identify associated future strategies that contribute to strengthening resilience attributes, using a backcasting approach. This paper synthesizes 1) the participatory identification of desired alternative systems and their expected performance on sustainability and resilience, 2) the participatory identification of strategies to realize those alternative systems, 3) the contribution of identified past and future strategies to 22 resilience attributes, and 4) the compatibility of the status quo and alternative systems with different future scenarios, the Eur-Agri-SSPs. Many identified alternative systems emphasized technology, diversification and organic and/or nature friendly farming, while in some farming systems also a focus on intensification, specialization, better product valorization, collaboration, or creating an attractive countryside could increase sustainability and resilience. Low economic viability limited farming system actors to pay attention to environmental and social functions. Further, most alternative systems were adaptations rather than transformations. Many stakeholders had difficulty to envisage systems without the main products (e.g., starch potato in NL-Arable, sheep in ES-Sheep and hazelnut in IT-Hazelnut), but in few cases transformative systems were designed (e.g. local organic farming in PL-Horticulture and RO-Mixed). Sustainability and resilience can be enhanced when alternative systems and strategies are combined, thereby improving multiple functions and attributes at once. In particular, production and legislation need to be coupled to local and natural capital. Identified alternative systems seem only compatible with Eur-Agri-SSP1 ‘agriculture on sustainable paths’. This requires policies at EU-level that stimulate macro-level social, institutional, economic, and technological developments that strengthen this scenario. We conclude that to get stakeholders along, incremental adaptation rather than radical transformation should be sought. The identification of alternative systems is only a start for the transition process. Their analysis, along with the strategies identified, need to trigger the involvement of farmers and other ‘enabling actors’ inside and outside the farming systems to make a change, and where needed, systems can evolve into more transformative systems.
articles.abstract_cn: 据利益相关者反映，许多欧洲农业系统在面临挑战（如干旱、价格下跌）、所发挥的功能（如经济可行性、生物多样性和栖息地）以及韧性所需属性（如社会组织性）方面已接近临界阈值。为加速向可持续和韧性农业的转型过程，本研究旨在通过回溯法，识别由行动者支持的欧洲10个农业系统中的替代系统，并确定有助于增强韧性属性的相关未来策略。本文综合了：1）参与式识别期望的替代系统及其在可持续性和韧性方面的预期表现；2）参与式识别实现这些替代系统的策略；3）已识别过去和未来策略对22项韧性属性的贡献；以及4）现状和替代系统与不同未来情景（Eur-Agri-SSPs）的兼容性。许多已识别的替代系统强调技术、多样化及有机和/或环境友好型农业，而在某些农业系统中，关注集约化、专业化、更好的产品价值化、合作或创造有吸引力的乡村也能提高可持续性和韧性。低经济可行性限制了农业系统行动者对环境和社会功能的关注。此外，大多数替代系统是适应而非转型。许多利益相关者难以设想没有主要产品的系统（如荷兰旱作区的淀粉马铃薯、西班牙牧羊区的绵羊和意大利榛子区的榛子），但在少数情况下设计了转型系统（如波兰园艺和罗马尼亚混合农业中的本地有机农业）。当替代系统和策略相结合时，可持续性和韧性可以得到增强，从而同时改善多种功能和属性。特别是，生产和立法需要与地方和自然资本相结合。已识别的替代系统似乎仅与Eur-Agri-SSP1‘可持续路径上的农业’情景兼容。这要求欧盟层面的政策刺激宏观层面的社会、制度、经济和技术发展，以强化这一情景。我们得出结论，要让利益相关者参与进来，应寻求渐进式适应而非激进转型。替代系统的识别只是转型过程的开始。对其分析以及已识别的策略，需要触发农民和农业系统内外其他‘赋能行动者’的参与以推动变革，并在必要时，系统可以演变为更具转型性的系统。

articles.title_en: A system lock-in blocks the uptake of mixed sustainable Eucalyptus plantations in Brazil
articles.title_cn: 系统锁定阻碍巴西混合可持续桉树人工林的推广
articles.abstract_en: Forest plantation areas across the globe are increasing in size and in 2019 Eucalyptus monocultures in Brazil covered 6.97 million hectares (0.8%). These monocultures hardly provide ecosystem services and do not support wildlife habitats. A transition towards more sustainable Eucalyptus plantations is urgently needed to support the provisioning of ecosystem services and conserve biodiversity. This transition requires the development of sustainable business models. We studied the upscaling of sustainable Eucalyptus plantation alternatives in Brazil, by analysing the potential barriers that need to be overcome using the Technological Innovation Systems perspective and semi-structured interviews of relevant stakeholders across the Eucalyptus value chain. Although the provisioning of ecosystem services is improved by alternative plantation management, we identified four blocking mechanisms that inhibit the functioning of the innovation system and as such hamper upscaling; 1) the productivist approach by incumbent actors on plantation management that is focussing only on short-term profit maximisation and results in a strong resistance to change current practices, 2) the weak societal and governmental vision that does not put sufficient pressure to change practices, 3) additional certification to support alternatives is in its infacy to develop niche markets which also hampers the development of financial support, and 4) failed demonstration projects in the past that have led to a lack of proof of concept for further experimentation and knowledge development. These barriers combined lead to a system lock-in, resistant to change and not capable for a diffusion of sustainable alternatives. We conclude that the directionality of a sustainability transformation should be enhanced by formulating long-term goals and strong commitment of public and private actors. We discuss how a mission oriented approach could foster such directionality for the urgently needed regime transformation in Eucalyptus paper and pulp production.
articles.abstract_cn: 全球人工林面积正在增加，2019年巴西的桉树单一栽培覆盖了6.97万公顷（0.8%）。这些单一栽培几乎不提供生态系统服务，也不支持野生动物栖息地。向更可持续的桉树人工林过渡迫在眉睫，以支持生态系统服务的提供和保护生物多样性。这一过渡需要开发可持续的商业模式。我们通过技术革新系统视角和对桉树价值链相关利益者的半结构化访谈，研究了巴西可持续桉树人工林替代方案的推广，分析了需要克服的潜在障碍。尽管替代性人工林管理改善了生态系统服务的提供，但我们识别出四种阻碍创新系统运作并因此阻碍推广的机制：1）现有参与者对人工林管理的生产主义方法只关注短期利润最大化，导致对改变当前实践的强烈抵制；2）社会和政府愿景薄弱，未施加足够压力改变实践；3）支持替代方案的额外认证处于初期阶段，难以发展利基市场，这也阻碍了金融支持的发展；4）过去失败的示范项目导致缺乏进一步实验和知识发展的概念验证。这些障碍共同导致系统锁定，抵制变化，无法传播可持续替代方案。我们得出结论，应通过制定长期目标和公共及私营部门的坚定承诺来增强可持续转型的方向性。我们讨论了任务导向方法如何促进这种方向性，以推动桉树纸浆和造纸生产中迫切需要的体制转型。

articles.title_en: Comments on Acosta-Velázquez et al. changes in mangrove coverage classification criteria could impact the conservation of mangroves in Mexico. Land Use Policy, 2023, 129, 106651
articles.title_cn: 对Acosta-Velázquez等人关于红树林覆盖分类标准变化可能影响墨西哥红树林保护的评论。土地利用政策，2023，129，106651
articles.abstract_en: Accurate and up-to-date mapping of mangrove habitats is crucial for effective conservation and management strategies and policies. As a reply to the comparative assessment realized by Acosta et al. (2023) to the last map produced by the Mexican Mangrove Monitoring System (MMMS) and the conclusions resulting from it, we provide a comprehensive response addressing the concerns raised. We acknowledge that maps are not infallible and are subject to improvement, particularly in the rapidly advancing field of remote sensing technology used in long term monitoring system. The MMMS mapping efforts utilize state-of-the-art remote sensing technologies, such as high-resolution satellite imagery and advanced methodologies, to enhance precision and efficiency. Moreover, MMMS mapping integrates regional external expert knowledge to increase accuracy at uncertain locations. We emphasize the importance of accuracy and reliability in mangrove mapping due to the potential irreversible consequences of mangrove loss. The MMMS provides a valuable tool for monitoring deforestation rates, understanding spatial distribution, supporting management decisions, identifying conservation priorities, and facilitating targeted conservation actions. We highlight the application of the precautionary principle as an environmental imperative for the Mexican government. The inclusion of previously classified "Other wetlands" as mangroves in the MMMS mapping system implies the acknowledgment of their integral role in supporting biodiversity and climate change mitigation efforts. Technological progress and collaborative efforts have made this reclassification possible, enhancing our understanding and expertise in distinguishing mangroves from other wetland types. We conclude that our mapping efforts align with the objective of attaining high classification accuracy in remote sensing, and we remain committed to continuous improvement in our mangrove mapping endeavors.
articles.abstract_cn: 准确且最新的红树林栖息地测绘对于有效的保护和管理策略及政策至关重要。作为对Acosta等人（2023）对墨西哥红树林监测系统（MMMS）最新地图进行的比较评估及其结论的回复，我们提供了全面的回应，以解决所提出的关切。我们承认地图并非绝对可靠，且有待改进，特别是在长期监测系统中使用的遥感技术快速发展的领域。MMMS的测绘工作利用最先进的遥感技术，如高分辨率卫星影像和先进方法，以提高精度和效率。此外，MMMS测绘整合了区域外部专家知识，以增加不确定地点的准确性。我们强调红树林测绘中准确性和可靠性的重要性，因为红树林丧失可能带来不可逆转的后果。MMMS为监测森林砍伐率、理解空间分布、支持管理决策、确定保护优先事项以及促进有针对性的保护行动提供了宝贵工具。我们强调将预防原则作为墨西哥政府的环境要务。MMMS测绘系统中将先前分类为“其他湿地”的区域纳入红树林，意味着承认它们在支持生物多样性和减缓气候变化努力中的整体作用。技术进步和协作努力使这一重新分类成为可能，增强了我们区分红树林与其他湿地类型的理解和专业知识。我们得出结论，我们的测绘工作与在遥感中实现高分类准确性的目标一致，并且我们致力于在红树林测绘工作中持续改进。

articles.title_en: Local to global escalation of land use conflicts: Long-term dynamics on social movements protests against pulp mills and plantation forests in Argentina and Uruguay
articles.title_cn: 土地利用冲突从地方到全球的升级：阿根廷和乌拉圭针对纸浆厂和人工林的社会运动抗议的长期动态
articles.abstract_en: Land-use conflicts are increasing in number and intensity. In conflicts involving power imbalances and structural asymmetries, actors may attempt to frame the conflict in a manner that would put it on the political agenda, sometimes causing an escalation of the conflict and extending the possibilities of new coalition partners. Consequently, this study aims to analyze the spread of conflict escalation across scales from the local to the international level, following political factors. We analyzed the conflict between Argentina and Uruguay over two pulp mill projects using a qualitative case study design with process tracing building on the content analysis of public documents and expert interviews. The results allow us to analyze the development of the conflict in three stages of escalation: local, international, and global. Our findings provide insights into conflict escalation patterns as important analytical concepts in land-use conflicts resulting from an active, strategic undertaking of political actors in pursuing strong allies at different levels of governance.
articles.abstract_cn: 土地利用冲突的数量和强度都在增加。在涉及权力失衡和结构性不对称的冲突中，行动者可能试图以某种方式构建冲突框架，使其进入政治议程，有时会导致冲突升级并扩大新联盟伙伴的可能性。因此，本研究旨在分析冲突升级从地方到国际层面的跨尺度传播，并关注政治因素。我们采用定性案例研究设计，结合过程追踪，基于公共文献的内容分析和专家访谈，分析了阿根廷和乌拉圭之间围绕两个纸浆厂项目的冲突。结果使我们能够分析冲突在三个升级阶段的发展：地方、国际和全球。我们的发现为冲突升级模式提供了见解，这些模式是土地利用冲突中的重要分析概念，源于政治行动者在不同治理层面积极寻求强大盟友的战略性举措。

articles.title_en: Policy development to support ecosystem services on pasture systems in Saskatchewan: A case study
articles.title_cn: 萨斯喀彻温省牧场系统生态系统服务支持的政策制定：案例研究
articles.abstract_en: Grasslands provide a wide variety of public and private environmental benefits arising from ecosystem services. At the same time, grassland ecosystems are being irreversibly altered. To protect grassland ecosystems and services, many policies have been introduced to encourage private grassland owners and users to adopt management practices to conserve and enhance ecosystem services. However, because such practices are largely voluntary, they are only effective if private ranchers and landowners opt in. The purpose of this case study was to identify acceptable and cost-effective policy tools to increase the provision of ecosystem services on Saskatchewan grasslands. A sample of Saskatchewan ranchers were surveyed to investigate their opinions and attitudes toward ecosystem services produced by grasslands, preferred policy parameters associated with grassland enhancement, and willingness-to-accept (WTA) to forego production in return for grassland conservation. The results indicated Saskatchewan ranchers place positive value on ecosystem services, but would require incentives ranging between $34.83 and $42.58 per acre ($86.06 and $105.21 per hectare) to compensate for a 10 % loss in production associated with increasing grassland conservation. Additionally, ranchers prefer policy options most closely aligned with their values indicating that conservation practices that enhance water quality and wildlife/habitat were far preferred to carbon sequestration. Results have implications for policy options and grassland conservation, particularly in a time where public grasslands in Saskatchewan have been privatized.
articles.abstract_cn: 草地通过生态系统服务提供了广泛的公共和私人环境效益。与此同时，草地生态系统正在被不可逆转地改变。为了保护草地生态系统和服务，许多政策已被引入，以鼓励私人草地所有者和使用者采用管理实践来保护和增强生态系统服务。然而，由于这些实践在很大程度上是自愿的，只有私人牧场主和土地所有者选择参与时才有效。本案例研究的目的是确定可接受且成本效益高的政策工具，以增加萨斯喀彻温省草地上生态系统服务的提供。对萨斯喀彻温省牧场主进行了抽样调查，以调查他们对草地产生的生态系统服务的看法和态度、与草地增强相关的首选政策参数，以及为草地保护而放弃生产的接受意愿（WTA）。结果表明，萨斯喀彻温省牧场主对生态系统服务赋予积极价值，但需要每英亩34.83美元至42.58美元（每公顷86.06美元至105.21美元）的激励，以补偿与增加草地保护相关的10%的生产损失。此外，牧场主更倾向于与其价值观最接近的政策选项，表明增强水质和野生动物/栖息地的保护实践远优于碳封存。结果对政策选项和草地保护具有启示意义，特别是在萨斯喀彻温省公共草地已被私有化的时期。

articles.title_en: Assessing the effectiveness, practicality and cost effectiveness of mitigation measures to reduce greenhouse gas emissions from intensively cultivated peatlands
articles.title_cn: 评估减少集约耕作泥炭地温室气体排放缓解措施的有效性、实用性和成本效益
articles.abstract_en: Peatlands drained for agriculture are among the most intensive sources of greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions from the land-use sector. Policy decisions on the most effective strategies to reduce GHG emissions in line with Paris Agreement goals, alongside strategies that can halt any ongoing soil and biodiversity losses, are hindered by a lack of understanding on how proposed mitigation measures are likely to be received by the farming sector. Research has identified effective GHG reduction measures, but successful on-farm adoption of these measures is contingent upon farmer perceptions of the relative practicality of implementing the measures, and the economic impact that adoption will have on the farm business. In this study, Best–Worst Scaling, a discrete choice survey method, was utilised to elicit expert (climate change, policy and biodiversity) and farmer opinion on the relative effectiveness, practicality and level of economic cost of mitigation measures that can reduce GHG emissions at the farm level. The method enabled individual mitigation measures to be ranked by effectiveness (expert opinion), practicality and economic cost (farmer opinions). There were no measures ranked as both effective and practical, or effective with low cost, but there were measures ranked by farmers as practical and low cost to implement. These included: more effective nutrient management, reduced or no tillage, the installation of buffer zones, increased fossil fuel efficiency and the optimisation of irrigation systems. The strong divergence of ‘effective’ measures on the one hand, and ‘practical’ and ‘economic’ measures on the other, highlights the major challenges involved in reducing high GHG emissions from agricultural organic soils. Resolving these challenges will require a combination of financial mechanisms to compensate farmers for higher costs and/or reduced yields, engagement and advice to support farmers in adopting changes in management practice, and agricultural innovation and adaptation to maintain overall food production and economic viability. If these challenges are overcome, more sustainable landscape management on agricultural lowland peat could make significant contributions to achieve national and international climate change targets.
articles.abstract_cn: 为农业而排水的泥炭地是土地利用部门温室气体（GHG）排放最密集的来源之一。根据《巴黎协定》目标制定最有效的温室气体减排战略，以及能够阻止持续土壤和生物多样性损失的战略，其政策决策因缺乏对拟议缓解措施可能被农业部门接受程度的理解而受阻。研究已确定了有效的温室气体减排措施，但这些措施在农场层面的成功采用取决于农民对实施措施相对实用性的看法，以及采用这些措施对农场经营的经济影响。在本研究中，采用最佳-最差标度法（一种离散选择调查方法）来征询专家（气候变化、政策和生物多样性）和农民对农场层面可减少温室气体排放的缓解措施相对有效性、实用性和经济成本水平的意见。该方法使各项缓解措施能够按有效性（专家意见）、实用性和经济成本（农民意见）进行排序。没有措施被同时评为有效且实用，或有效且低成本，但有一些措施被农民评为实用且实施成本低。这些措施包括：更有效的养分管理、减少或免耕、安装缓冲区、提高化石燃料效率以及优化灌溉系统。一方面“有效”措施与另一方面“实用”和“经济”措施之间的强烈分歧，凸显了减少农业有机土壤高温室气体排放所涉及的重大挑战。解决这些挑战需要结合财务机制以补偿农民较高的成本和/或较低的产量，参与和咨询以支持农民采用管理实践的改变，以及农业创新和适应以维持整体粮食生产和经济可行性。如果这些挑战得到克服，农业低地泥炭上更可持续的景观管理可以为实现国家和国际气候变化目标做出重大贡献。

articles.title_en: The nature of a ‘forest transition’ in Thừa Thiên Huế Province, Central Vietnam – A study of land cover changes over five decades
articles.title_cn: 越南中部承天顺化省“森林转型”的性质——一项跨越五十年的土地覆盖变化研究
articles.abstract_en: Informed from historical case studies of land cover change and development in northern countries, forest transition (FT) theories have a tendency to precast specific conclusions. Considering the case of a so-called FT in Thừa Thiên Huế Province in tropical Central Vietnam, we investigated 1.) whether such a ‘FT’ indeed reflects a resurgence of genuine forest, 2.) whether the land cover changes can be explained through conventional ‘pathways’ of FT, and 3.) in which ways the changes may or may not portend ‘sustainable development’. Using satellite imagery and topographic maps, we produced maps for twenty land cover types for the years 1966, 1973, 1979, 1988, 1998, 2008, 2016 and 2019 and analysed land cover change over time. We contextualize these results with reference to the historical and scientific literature on Vietnam, and find that 1.) the forestlands represent a historically rich bio-cultural landscape; 2.) considerable forest destruction resulted from the Second Indochina War rather than classical degradation pathways; 3.) in the post-war period altered forestland spaces and re-emerging land uses interacted with state-led re-territorialization and socialist plans for land resource development, influencing shifts in forest cover; 4.) during 1979–1988 state-led intensive timber logging in remaining rainforests (causing widespread forest degradation) somewhat paradoxically (in terms of conventional FT models and theories) coincided already with a slight increase in lower-biomass tree cover; 5.) after 1988 logging in natural forests was officially prohibited (logging bans), and forestry shifted to a reliance on wood produced in acacia-based plantations (largely on lands officially allocated to households); and 6.) this shift went along with a significant state-led restructuring and development of land use policies and the promotion of forest-relevant economic industries. ‘Restoration’ of tree cover mainly consisted of the expansion of exotic tree plantations, but – at least intermittently – this may also have mitigated impacts on natural forests. We conclude with some reflections on the FT-outcome, its ‘sustainability’, and future trajectories and possibilities of land cover changes in TTHP.
articles.abstract_cn: 基于北方国家土地覆盖变化与发展的历史案例研究，森林转型（FT）理论倾向于预设特定结论。以热带越南中部承天顺化省所谓的FT为例，我们调查了1.）这种“FT”是否确实反映了真正森林的复苏，2.）土地覆盖变化能否通过FT的常规“路径”来解释，以及3.）这些变化可能或不可能预示“可持续发展”的方式。利用卫星影像和地形图，我们为1966、1973、1979、1988、1998、2008、2016和2019年制作了二十种土地覆盖类型的地图，并分析了随时间变化的土地覆盖变化。我们结合越南历史和科学文献对这些结果进行背景化分析，发现1.）林地代表了历史上丰富的生物文化景观；2.）相当规模的森林破坏源于第二次印度支那战争，而非典型的退化路径；3.）战后时期，林地空间的变化和重新出现的土地利用与国家主导的再领土化及社会主义土地资源开发计划相互作用，影响了森林覆盖的变化；4.）在1979-1988年间，国家主导的剩余雨林高强度木材采伐（导致广泛的森林退化）与低生物量树木覆盖的轻微增加同时发生，这在常规FT模型和理论看来有些矛盾；5.）1988年后，天然林采伐被正式禁止（禁伐令），林业转向依赖相思树种植园（主要在正式分配给农户的土地上）生产的木材；以及6.）这一转变伴随着国家主导的土地利用政策重组和发展以及森林相关经济产业的推广。“恢复”树木覆盖主要包括外来树种种植园的扩张，但至少间歇性地，这可能也减轻了对天然林的影响。最后，我们对FT结果、其“可持续性”以及TTHP土地覆盖变化的未来轨迹和可能性进行了一些反思。

articles.title_en: Farmer typologies integrating latent and observed characteristics: Insights for soil and water conservation outreach
articles.title_cn: 整合潜在与观测特征的农户类型学：对水土保持推广的启示
articles.abstract_en: One of the fundamental rules of effective communication is to “know your audience.” When engaging farmers in conservation in the U.S. and elsewhere where their participation is voluntary, communication should start with the fundamental recognition that farmers are heterogeneous in many ways; their attitudes, values, and motivations, as well as their farms’ biophysical and economic characteristics, can influence their behaviors. Previous typology research in Iowa, USA using data from a panel survey of farmers, revealed heterogeneity by identifying four types of farmers—Conservationists, Deliberative, Productivists, and Traditionalists—based on latent class analysis of variables measuring varied dimensions of awareness, attitudes, beliefs, perceived motivations, and barriers to practice adoption. The study presented in this article advances the typology by associating observable variables from the same survey (e.g., farmer demographics, farm enterprises, participation in conservation programs, adoption of conservation practices) with the four farmer types. The Conservationist type was the most educated and indicated a high intention of adopting cover crops. The Deliberative type tended not to have a conservation plan with the U.S. Department of Agriculture Natural Resources Conservation Service. The Productivist farmer farmed the most land, rented and owned, and had the highest no-till implementation in land size and percentage of the group. The Traditionalist type rented the least amount of land. We expect outreach professionals, watershed coordinators, and conservation practitioners can use observable characteristics to segment the farmer population and improve conservation messages by tailoring them to the specific farmer types, leading to a higher return on investment in terms of money, time, and goodwill.
articles.abstract_cn: 有效沟通的基本规则之一是“了解你的受众”。在美国及其他农户自愿参与保护的地方，与农户沟通应首先认识到农户在许多方面存在异质性；他们的态度、价值观和动机，以及其农场的生物物理和经济特征，都可能影响其行为。此前在爱荷华州（美国）使用农户固定样本调查数据进行的类型学研究，通过潜在类别分析衡量意识、态度、信念、感知动机和采用实践障碍等不同维度的变量，识别出四种农户类型——保护主义者、深思熟虑型、生产主义者和传统主义者，从而揭示了异质性。本文所述研究通过将同一调查中的可观测变量（如农户人口统计特征、农场企业、参与保护项目、采用保护实践）与四种农户类型相关联，推进了类型学的发展。保护主义者类型受教育程度最高，并表现出采用覆盖作物的高意愿。深思熟虑型往往没有与美国农业部自然资源保护局签订保护计划。生产者型农户耕种的土地最多，包括租入和自有土地，并且在免耕实施面积和占该组比例方面最高。传统主义者类型租入的土地最少。我们期望推广专业人员、流域协调员和保护实践者能够利用可观测特征对农户群体进行细分，并通过针对特定农户类型定制保护信息来改进保护宣传，从而在资金、时间和善意方面获得更高的投资回报。

articles.title_en: The value of green infrastructure to property prices: Evidence from the Gold Coast, Queensland, Australia
articles.title_cn: 绿色基础设施对房产价值的影响：来自澳大利亚昆士兰州黄金海岸的证据
articles.abstract_en: Green infrastructure supports residential choice, provides sustainable transport and contributes to liveable neighbourhoods. This study investigates the value of green infrastructure, defined as built environment features (e.g., green spaces, beaches), facilities (e.g., fitness equipment in parks) and sustainable transport infrastructure (e.g., heavy rail, light rail and bus), to property prices in the Gold Coast, Queensland, Australia as a case study. The main difference of this study from previous ones is the evaluation scope is not limited or attached to a particular transport infrastructure project but instead considers a whole city. The impacts of green infrastructure are measured taking account of geographical differences across the city using a multi-level regression modelling approach to identify the implicit value of green infrastructure in residential property prices. The results suggest only those elements of green infrastructure that can provide a direct service to people (e.g., fitness equipment) are positively valued. Importantly from a sustainable transport perspective, the current public transport network and services have a negative impact on property price suggesting public transport might not be meeting property owners’ expectations. The paper discusses the implications of the model results for literature and policy on green infrastructure.
articles.abstract_cn: 绿色基础设施支持住宅选择，提供可持续交通，并有助于宜居社区。本研究以澳大利亚昆士兰州黄金海岸为案例，探讨绿色基础设施（定义为建成环境特征（如绿地、海滩）、设施（如公园内的健身器材）和可持续交通基础设施（如重轨、轻轨和公交））对房产价值的影响。本研究与以往研究的主要区别在于，评估范围不限于或依附于特定交通基础设施项目，而是考虑整个城市。采用多水平回归建模方法，考虑城市不同区域的地理差异，衡量绿色基础设施的影响，以识别绿色基础设施在住宅房产价格中的隐含价值。结果表明，只有那些能为人们提供直接服务的绿色基础设施要素（如健身器材）才被积极估价。重要的是，从可持续交通的角度来看，当前的公共交通网络和服务对房产价格有负面影响，表明公共交通可能未达到业主的期望。本文讨论了模型结果对绿色基础设施文献和政策的启示。

articles.title_en: The capitalization of CAP subsidies into land prices in the EU
articles.title_cn: 欧盟共同农业政策补贴在土地价格中的资本化
articles.abstract_en: The objective of this paper is to estimate the capitalization of CAP subsidies into both rental prices and land values in the EU. We use FADN data at regional level for the period 1989–2016 and apply a dynamic panel approach (GMM estimator) to estimate the capitalization effect of coupled direct payments (CDPs), decoupled direct payments (DDPs) and rural development measures at EU level. The estimated results suggest that the short-run (long-run) capitalization rate of DDPs into land rents vary between 9.1% and 46.2% (11% and 55%) and DDPs implementation details matter. Compared to the flat-rate models, the heterogeneous DDPs models appear to have capitalization rates lower by between 34% and 37% in the short-run and between 41% and 45% in the long-run. CDPs are associated with capitalization rates of around 6% in the short-run and 7% in the long-run. No clear capitalization effect could be found for rural development measures. In contrast to rental prices, estimates for land values suggest that only DDPs may cause a capitalization rate between 28.8% and 32.1% in the short-run and between 154% and 164% in the long-run. However, estimates for land values are not robust and consistent across estimated models. Using more robust capitalization estimates for rental prices, the results indicate that only 10–12% of the overall EU CAP payments were leaked to non-farming landowners in 2016. However, there is a sizable variation in the non-farming landowners' gains across Member States, ranging from 2% to 37%.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文旨在估计欧盟共同农业政策（CAP）补贴在租金价格和土地价值中的资本化程度。我们使用1989-2016年期间区域层面的农场会计数据网络（FADN）数据，并应用动态面板方法（GMM估计量）来估计欧盟层面挂钩直接支付（CDPs）、脱钩直接支付（DDPs）和农村发展措施的资本化效应。估计结果表明，DDPs对土地租金的短期（长期）资本化率介于9.1%和46.2%（11%和55%）之间，且DDPs的实施细节至关重要。与统一费率模型相比，异质性DDPs模型的资本化率在短期低34%至37%，在长期低41%至45%。CDPs的资本化率在短期约为6%，在长期约为7%。对于农村发展措施，未发现明确的资本化效应。与租金价格相比，土地价值的估计表明，只有DDPs可能在短期产生28.8%至32.1%的资本化率，在长期产生154%至164%的资本化率。然而，土地价值的估计在估计模型中并不稳健和一致。使用更稳健的租金价格资本化估计，结果表明，在2016年，欧盟CAP总支付中仅有10-12%流向了非农业土地所有者。然而，各成员国非农业土地所有者的收益存在显著差异，范围从2%到37%。

articles.title_en: A co-design framework for natural resource policy making: Insights from tree health and fisheries in the United Kingdom
articles.title_cn: 自然资源政策制定的协同设计框架：来自英国树木健康与渔业的启示
articles.abstract_en: Environmental and land use policy literature asserts the need for more holistic, participatory and co-designed forms of governance for the sustainable management of natural resources. Co-design is also increasingly recognised by government as a useful approach but is often applied with varying degrees of success. The purpose of this paper is to assess recent examples of policy co-design across three UK case studies focused on tree/woodland management and fisheries. The first set out to co-design criteria for ‘low impact’ fishing with fisheries stakeholders to inform new fisheries policy and management strategies. The second co-designed new policy options with tree/woodland stakeholders to replace existing tree health grants, as part of the UK government’s broader Environment Land Management scheme. The third aimed to scope, with stakeholders, the potential for a new social survey of fishers. Despite the different contexts, all projects sought to apply principles of co-design by engaging with stakeholders during the early stages of policy development. A comparative assessment between the three case studies allows us to identify challenges for co-design and to provide recommendations for successfully applying co-design principles through stakeholder-researcher-policy maker partnerships. Challenges include building trust between stakeholders and policymakers, overcoming traditional modes of evidence-based policy making, accessing hard-to-reach groups, getting discussions to move beyond the general to the specific, and recognising that co-design takes time and is resource-intensive. A new co-design framework is presented, setting out five stages for incorporating the principles of co-design in natural resource policy making: scoping, co-design, testing, implementing and evaluation.
articles.abstract_cn: 环境与土地利用政策文献主张，为了自然资源的可持续管理，需要更整体性、参与性和协同设计的治理形式。协同设计也日益被政府认可为一种有用的方法，但应用时往往取得不同程度的成功。本文旨在评估英国三个聚焦于树木/林地管理和渔业的案例研究中的政策协同设计近期实例。第一个案例旨在与渔业利益相关者共同设计“低影响”捕捞的标准，为新的渔业政策和管理策略提供信息。第二个案例与树木/林地利益相关者共同设计新的政策选项，以取代现有的树木健康补助，作为英国政府更广泛的环境土地管理计划的一部分。第三个案例旨在与利益相关者探讨对渔民进行新的社会调查的可能性。尽管背景不同，所有项目都试图在政策制定的早期阶段通过与利益相关者接触来应用协同设计原则。对三个案例研究进行比较评估，使我们能够识别协同设计面临的挑战，并为通过利益相关者-研究者-政策制定者伙伴关系成功应用协同设计原则提供建议。挑战包括在利益相关者和政策制定者之间建立信任，克服传统的基于证据的政策制定模式，接触难以触及的群体，使讨论超越一般性而具体化，以及认识到协同设计需要时间且资源密集。提出了一个新的协同设计框架，阐述了在自然资源政策制定中纳入协同设计原则的五个阶段：范围界定、协同设计、测试、实施和评估。

articles.title_en: Typologies of stations’ catchment areas in metropolitan urban peripheries: From car-oriented to sustainable urban strategies
articles.title_cn: 大都市边缘地区车站影响区类型学：从汽车导向到可持续城市战略
articles.abstract_en: After decades of sprawl and car-dependent urban developments, especially on the peripheries of metropolitan areas, new policies are being oriented towards more efficient and sustainable mobility. In the process of change towards more sustainable mobility patterns in peripheral areas, commuter railways must play a predominant role because of their capacity and speed. The main aim of this paper is to analyse commuter rail stations’ catchment areas (SCAs) to identify typologies of these nodes in large metropolitan areas as a key step in proposing strategies for making mobility much more sustainable, both in the medium and proximity scales, by promoting soft mobility towards stations, a strategy that will facilitate commuters’ use of daily rail transport. The method proposed is based on a twofold clustering analysis. The first is to consider urban-planning variables to detect consolidated stations; the second is to use both public space and land-use variables to characterise the quality of the urban environment for walking/cycling. These methods are applied in the metropolitan area of Madrid and offer some key insights. The results show that different typologies are found – from consolidated, dense and mixed-use SCAs, with large residential developments, to low-density SCAs in sprawl areas or low consolidated mixed-use SCAs with large parking spaces, following the park-and-ride model, among others. This identification of SCAs’ typologies is key for policy makers to propose different strategies, which could be small projects oriented towards improving public spaces promoting soft mobility, or deeper changes that require a re-densification process in the stations’ surroundings, breaking with the rigid definition of transit-oriented developments and adapting the decisions taken to each context.
articles.abstract_cn: 经过数十年的城市蔓延和依赖汽车的城市发展，尤其是在大都市边缘地区，新政策正转向更高效和可持续的出行方式。在边缘地区向更可持续出行模式转变的过程中，通勤铁路因其运力和速度必须发挥主导作用。本文的主要目的是分析通勤铁路车站影响区（SCAs），以识别大都市区域中这些节点的类型学，作为提出使出行更加可持续战略的关键步骤，无论是在中观尺度还是邻近尺度，通过促进向车站的软性出行，这一战略将有助于通勤者日常使用铁路交通。提出的方法基于双重聚类分析。首先考虑城市规划变量以识别已整合的车站；其次使用公共空间和土地利用变量来表征步行/骑行城市环境的质量。这些方法应用于马德里大都市区，并提供了一些关键见解。结果表明，发现了不同的类型——从整合的、密集的、混合用途的SCAs，拥有大型住宅开发项目，到蔓延地区的低密度SCAs，或低整合度混合用途且拥有大型停车空间的SCAs，遵循停车换乘模式等。这种SCAs类型学的识别对于政策制定者提出不同战略至关重要，这些战略可以是旨在改善公共空间促进软性出行的小型项目，或是需要车站周边再密集化过程的更深层次变革，打破公交导向开发的严格定义，并根据每个情境调整决策。

articles.title_en: Private-led land assembly and urban consolidation: The relative influence of regulatory zoning mechanisms
articles.title_cn: 私人主导的土地整合与城市集约化：监管分区机制的相对影响
articles.abstract_en: From the time a city is first subdivided, its structure of lots act as a precursor to all future redevelopment, forming the spatial bounds of land ownership that force buildings to develop and evolve in their place. It is therefore critical for planning systems that intend to contain urban sprawl to encourage the lot superstructure to adapt to the emerging needs of a city. This study assesses the role that existing regulatory planning mechanisms play in directing the spatial distribution and frequency of private developer-led land assembly. Drawing on two inner city local government areas in Melbourne, Australia, this research analyses the relative influence of local zone-led development controls on the occurrence of land assembly over an eleven-year period. A descriptive spatial analysis and global logistic regression model reveal that an interplay of maximum height restrictions, existing plot boundaries, and sales prices, have led to a disordered distribution of parcel amalgamations. A geographically weighted logistic regression model highlights spatial variation in the influence of these factors, with small lots in the inner city being subject to the least influence of development controls. The results are supplemented by a small sample of interviews with local planners and developers, who suggest that regulatory planning controls inadvertently turn desired built form outcomes into a tool for capital appreciation and landowner holdouts. In combination, the findings suggest that zone-led development controls do little to influence market forces in a manner that induces private-led land assembly in favour of the public good.
articles.abstract_cn: 从城市首次细分之时起，其地块结构便成为所有未来再开发的先导，形成土地所有权的空间边界，迫使建筑在其位置上发展和演变。因此，对于旨在遏制城市蔓延的规划系统而言，鼓励地块上层结构适应城市新兴需求至关重要。本研究评估了现有监管规划机制在引导私人开发商主导的土地整合的空间分布和频率方面所发挥的作用。本研究以澳大利亚墨尔本两个内城区地方政府区域为对象，分析了地方分区主导的开发控制对十一年期间土地整合发生的相对影响。描述性空间分析和全局逻辑回归模型揭示，最大高度限制、现有地块边界和销售价格的相互作用导致了地块合并的无序分布。地理加权逻辑回归模型突出了这些因素影响的空间差异，内城区的小地块受开发控制的影响最小。研究结果辅以对当地规划者和开发商的小样本访谈，他们表示，监管规划控制无意中将期望的建筑形式结果转变为资本增值和土地所有者抵制开发的工具。综合来看，研究结果表明，分区主导的开发控制对市场力量的影响甚微，无法以有利于公共利益的方式诱导私人主导的土地整合。

articles.title_en: Institutional analysis and informal urban settlements: A proposition for a new institutionalist grounded property rights perspective
articles.title_cn: 制度分析与非正规城市住区：一种新制度主义扎根产权视角的提议
articles.abstract_en: This paper proposes a generic process for conducting research on property rights in informal settlements from a new institutionalist perspective. The paper is premised on the fact that informal urban settlements have peculiar characteristics that complicate investigations using conventional methods. However, analytical approaches based on new institutionalism have gradually gained prominence over more traditional approaches amongst scholars in developing countries. New institutionalist methods of juxtaposing investigations of formal and informal institutions and relaxing some of the assumptions of conventional theories have enabled the inclusion of situations involving incomplete or imperfect property rights and positive transaction costs in the analysis. This paper shows that a “new institutionalist perspective” is not one coherent school of thought but rather a diverse group of theories with some common tenets dominated by three varieties of institutionalism, namely, rational choice, historical, and sociological. While a common framework would be ideal, this paper instead advocates for a dynamic research process that can be customised for examinations of property rights in different informal settlements, thus contributing to the literature by extending the application of new institutionalism to situations with “incomplete” property rights.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一种从新制度主义视角对非正规住区产权进行研究的一般性过程。本文的前提是非正规城市住区具有特殊特征，这些特征使采用常规方法进行调查复杂化。然而，在发展中国家学者中，基于新制度主义的分析方法已逐渐比更传统的方法更为突出。新制度主义方法将正式与非正式制度的调查并列，并放宽了传统理论的一些假设，使得在分析中能够纳入涉及不完整或不完全产权以及正交易成本的情况。本文表明，“新制度主义视角”并非一个连贯的思想流派，而是一组具有某些共同原则的多样化理论，主要由三种制度主义变体主导，即理性选择、历史和社会学。虽然一个共同框架是理想的，但本文反而倡导一种动态研究过程，该过程可针对不同非正规住区的产权考察进行定制，从而通过将新制度主义的应用扩展到“不完整”产权的情况来为文献做出贡献。

articles.title_en: Impact of land tenure security through customary law on agricultural productivity in Burkina Faso: Propensity score matching approaches
articles.title_cn: 布基纳法索习惯法下土地保有权保障对农业生产率的影响：倾向得分匹配方法
articles.abstract_en: Land tenure security plays an important role in agricultural production systems. The objective of this paper is to empirically assess the impact of land tenure security through customary law on agricultural productivity in Burkina Faso. We use panel data from 15,627 agricultural households over the period 2019–2021. Four propensity score matching methods are used: the nearest neighbor method, the stratification method, the radius method and the kernel method. The instrumental variables technique was used to control for endogeneity. Overall, the results indicate that household land security improves agricultural productivity. The minimum gain in agricultural productivity is estimated to be USD 86.4 per agricultural asset per season for households with customary land tenure. In terms of economic policy implications, the results call on the authorities in charge of conducting agricultural policies to promote comprehensive land policies by adapting them to local contexts through the recognition of customary institutions for rural land management.
articles.abstract_cn: 土地保有权保障在农业生产系统中扮演着重要角色。本文旨在实证评估布基纳法索习惯法下土地保有权保障对农业生产率的影响。我们使用了2019-2021年间15,627个农业家庭的面板数据。采用了四种倾向得分匹配方法：最近邻法、分层法、半径法和核法。工具变量技术被用于控制内生性。总体而言，结果表明家庭土地保障提高了农业生产率。对于拥有习惯土地保有权家庭，农业生产率的最小增益估计为每季每项农业资产86.4美元。在经济政策含义方面，结果呼吁负责实施农业政策的当局通过承认农村土地管理的习惯制度，将综合土地政策适应当地情况，以促进土地政策的实施。

articles.title_en: Farm typology and structure of farmer decision making: The case of the production basin of the forest-savannah transition zone, Centre Cameroon Region
articles.title_cn: 农场类型学与农民决策结构：喀麦隆中部地区森林-稀树草原过渡带生产流域的案例
articles.abstract_en: Despite having a similar environment, not all of the farmers in a given region have the same history. They don't always share the same traits, and they don't always have the same access to land or diverse natural environment resources. This study aims to describe how agricultural production is organized in the Mbangassina-Ntui-Batchenga-Obala areas to improve food security, where agriculture is the primary economic activity. On 180 farms, mixed data were gathered, and a factorial analysis of the mixed data, along with a hierarchical ascending classification, allowed for the differentiation of 4 groups of farms. Farms in Type 1 (44.44%) have an average size of 2.51 ha, are predominately run by men, primarily employ family labor, and have the highest proportion of farmers. The majority of Type 3 farms (34.44%), which have an average area of 6.62 ha, are run by men and mostly employ family labor. The producers in this group are vulnerable to climate change and lack adaptation plans. Finally, 4 types of farms, which have an average size of 10.9 ha and are operated by both men and women utilizing family labor, account for 5.56% of all farms. All of these farmers are creating adaptation strategies as they recognize the effects of climate change. Through a correct understanding of the reasons that underpin the diversity of farms, this classification serves as a basis for the design of appropriate public policies. Taking into account this diversity of agricultural situations in the northern part of the Centre Cameroon Region is essential for the success of research and rural development operations. In addition, it would allow a more relevant use of typologies of knowledge on farms as a tool for sustainable development and decision support.
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管环境相似，但某一地区的农民并非都有相同的历史。他们并不总是具有相同的特征，也不总是拥有相同的土地或多样化自然环境资源的获取途径。本研究旨在描述姆班加西纳-恩图伊-巴琴加-奥巴拉地区的农业生产组织方式，以改善粮食安全，该地区农业是主要经济活动。在180个农场收集了混合数据，对混合数据进行因子分析，并结合层次升序分类，区分出4组农场。类型1的农场（44.44%）平均面积为2.51公顷，主要由男性经营，主要使用家庭劳动力，且农民比例最高。类型3的农场（34.44%）平均面积为6.62公顷，主要由男性经营，主要使用家庭劳动力。该群体的生产者易受气候变化影响，且缺乏适应计划。最后，类型4的农场平均面积为10.9公顷，由男性和女性共同经营并使用家庭劳动力，占所有农场的5.56%。所有这些农民都认识到气候变化的影响，并正在制定适应策略。通过正确理解农场多样性背后的原因，该分类为设计适当的公共政策提供了基础。考虑到喀麦隆中部地区北部农业情况的多样性，对于研究和农村发展行动的成功至关重要。此外，它将允许更相关地使用农场知识类型学作为可持续发展和决策支持的工具。

articles.title_en: How to recognize the role of policy clusters in built-up land intensity: An empirical case of the Yangtze River Economic Belt of China
articles.title_cn: 如何识别政策集群在建设用地强度中的作用：以中国长江经济带为例的实证研究
articles.abstract_en: The dependence of economic and population growth on built-up land cannot be overly blamed, but it needs to be looked at closely when it goes against the principles of sustainable growth. Rapid urbanization and industrialization have led to extensive land use, and many policies have been introduced with the aim of creating clustering effects to mitigate this issue. The Yangtze River Economic Belt (YREB) of China is a typical case to make up for the fact that the role of policy clusters in built-up land intensity (BLI) is not yet fully recognized. First, the intensive use policy clusters (IUPC) of the YREB have undergone evolutionary characteristics of growth, maturity and renewal since their formal birth in 2008. Second, quantitative evidence from time-series observations and policy simulations demonstrates an effective contribution of IUPC to BLI (an average 43.1% enhancement). Worryingly, however, despite the "lifting benefit", the BLI is expected to show a "decreasing trend". Finally, the combined results are fed back to the IUPC, showing that both the abundance and heterogeneity of the policy clusters affect the impact. Specific recommendations for future policy development are made based on the above results. This study provides a pragmatic and rigorous mindset and case for policy research.
articles.abstract_cn: 经济增长和人口增长对建设用地的依赖不应被过度指责，但当其违背可持续增长原则时，需要密切关注。快速的城市化和工业化导致了土地粗放利用，许多政策旨在通过形成集群效应来缓解这一问题。中国长江经济带（YREB）是一个典型案例，用以弥补政策集群在建设用地强度（BLI）中的作用尚未被充分认识的事实。首先，自2008年正式诞生以来，长江经济带的集约利用政策集群（IUPC）经历了增长、成熟和更新的演化特征。其次，来自时间序列观测和政策模拟的定量证据表明，IUPC对BLI有有效贡献（平均增强43.1%）。然而，令人担忧的是，尽管存在“提升效益”，BLI预计将呈现“下降趋势”。最后，将综合结果反馈给IUPC，表明政策集群的丰富性和异质性都会影响其影响。基于上述结果，提出了未来政策制定的具体建议。本研究为政策研究提供了务实且严谨的思路和案例。

articles.title_en: Zoning for character: Contextual rezoning and socioeconomic change in New York City neighborhoods, 1986–2019
articles.title_cn: 为特色而分区：纽约市街区的文脉性重新分区与社会经济变迁，1986-2019年
articles.abstract_en: Empirical research is increasingly evaluating how municipal rezonings may affect the racial and socioeconomic characteristics of neighborhoods over time. There are also some zoning types that are not intended to affect development capacity and are based on the policy rationale of protecting urban character. Contextual rezonings are one such type and apply a layer of mandatory regulation on building height, setbacks from the street line, and yard requirements to create more restrictive but visually interesting building envelopes. In the American context, bundled with the notion of urban character are also discriminatory biases about the demographic characteristics of who should be allowed to live in urban neighborhoods and whose presence adds economic value. There is a need for additional studies that examine how character-based zoning controls may also be implicated in forms of neighborhood change, particularly exclusionary practices. This paper contributes to the literature by examining the neighborhood socioeconomic impacts of contextual rezonings implemented in New York City between 1986 and 2019 using a difference-in-difference method. The findings indicate that after implementation, contextually zoned neighborhoods tend to increase in socioeconomic status and become more predominately white and affluent. These changes represent a further entrenchment of white isolation that solidifies related privileges.
articles.abstract_cn: 实证研究越来越多地评估市政重新分区如何可能随时间影响街区的种族和社会经济特征。也有一些分区类型并非旨在影响开发容量，而是基于保护城市特色的政策理由。文脉性重新分区就是其中一种类型，它对建筑高度、街道线后退距离和庭院要求施加一层强制性规定，以创造更具限制性但视觉上有趣的建筑轮廓。在美国背景下，与城市特色概念捆绑在一起的还有关于谁应该被允许居住在城市街区以及谁的存在增加经济价值的人口特征的歧视性偏见。需要更多的研究来考察基于特色的分区控制是否也可能涉及街区变化的形式，特别是排斥性做法。本文通过使用双重差分法，考察了1986年至2019年间在纽约市实施的文脉性重新分区的街区社会经济影响，为文献做出了贡献。研究结果表明，实施后，文脉性分区的街区往往社会经济地位上升，并变得更加以白人和富裕人口为主。这些变化代表了白人隔离的进一步固化，从而巩固了相关特权。

articles.title_en: What factors guide the recent Spanish model for the disposal of military land in the neoliberal era?
articles.title_cn: 新自由主义时代西班牙军事用地处置模式的影响因素是什么？
articles.abstract_en: This work drafts a general framework about the disposal policies fostered by the Spanish Ministry of Defence since the 1980 s, which is apparently understudied in comparison with emerging international research. The research seeks two main goals. The first is to demonstrate that these policies have followed the general trend of neoliberal restructuring of the public sector, as it happened in countries like France, Italy, and the UK. In the face of austerity and deep state cuts in military spending, the MoD sells (off) its estate to reduce the real estate management and maintenance costs and generate financial gains from sales. The second goal is to highlight the primarily financial approach of the MoD disposal policies. Although military land may catalyse significant urban transformation, the disposal policies have sought direct economic revenue for the central government and the MoD.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文构建了一个关于西班牙国防部自1980年代以来推行的处置政策的总体框架，与国际上新兴的研究相比，这一主题显然研究不足。研究旨在实现两个主要目标。第一是证明这些政策遵循了公共部门新自由主义重组的总体趋势，正如法国、意大利和英国等国家所发生的那样。面对紧缩政策和国家军事开支的大幅削减，国防部出售其地产以降低房地产管理和维护成本，并从销售中产生财务收益。第二个目标是强调国防部处置政策的主要财务导向。尽管军事用地可能催化显著的城市转型，但处置政策旨在为中央政府和国防部带来直接的经济收入。

articles.title_en: Are we promoting green cities in Latin America and the Caribbean? Exploring the patterns and drivers of change for urban vegetation
articles.title_cn: 我们是否在推动拉丁美洲和加勒比地区的绿色城市？探索城市植被变化的模式与驱动因素
articles.abstract_en: As cities opt for green policies to address urban socio-ecological challenges it becomes important to evaluate how the urban landscape responds to them, and if these responses are strengthening the benefits of nature for all. The Latin American and Caribbean (LAC) region is one of the most biodiverse and urbanized regions of the world, which makes it imperative to understand how greening policies have impacted the distribution, accessibility, and quantity of vegetated areas in cities through time. Using a landscape ecology approach, we explored the effects of local urban dynamics on the pathways of urban vegetation in ten LAC capital cities in the last 20 years. Our results showed a great fluctuation of vegetation cover change for the region, with Santiago (Chile) losing more than 10% of its urban vegetation to Brasilia gaining 19%, while fragmentation and inequities in the distribution of vegetation increased in all cities. Cities followed four pathways of vegetation change, displaying different patterns of change in fragmentation, size of the vegetated patches and their clustering. This discloses that the greening policies and actions adopted in LAC cities led to increased vegetation cover, or avoided its loss, but did not assure a better distribution of the green and its benefits. Vegetation in LAC cities are still fragmented, where vegetation is not connected and is not equitably distributed, showing that policies in place have not addressed distributional injustice yet. This is corroborated by the assessment of drivers of change where we found social factors were the most important determinants of urban vegetation dynamics. Results from our study provide evidence for developing policies towards urban greening and connectivity, not only to prevent further biodiversity loss but also for creating more resilient communities and cities that address environmental inequities.
articles.abstract_cn: 随着城市选择绿色政策来应对城市社会生态挑战，评估城市景观如何响应这些政策，以及这些响应是否正在增强自然对所有人的益处变得重要。拉丁美洲和加勒比（LAC）地区是世界上生物多样性最丰富且城市化程度最高的地区之一，这使得理解绿化政策如何随时间影响城市植被区域的分布、可达性和数量变得至关重要。采用景观生态学方法，我们探讨了地方城市动态对过去20年间十个LAC首都城市植被变化路径的影响。我们的结果显示该地区植被覆盖变化波动很大，从智利圣地亚哥失去超过10%的城市植被到巴西利亚增加19%，同时所有城市的植被破碎化及其分布不平等现象加剧。城市遵循四种植被变化路径，表现出破碎化、植被斑块大小及其聚集性的不同变化模式。这表明LAC城市采取的绿化政策和行动增加了植被覆盖或避免了其损失，但并未确保绿色及其益处的更好分配。LAC城市的植被仍然破碎化，植被不连通且分布不均，表明现有政策尚未解决分配不公问题。这一点通过驱动因素评估得到证实，我们发现社会因素是城市植被动态最重要的决定因素。我们的研究结果为制定城市绿化和连通性政策提供了证据，不仅是为了防止进一步的生物多样性丧失，也是为了创建更具韧性的社区和城市，以解决环境不平等问题。

articles.title_en: Intergenerational perceptions of the collective action challenges facing Mexican community forests
articles.title_cn: 代际视角下的墨西哥社区森林面临的集体行动挑战
articles.abstract_en: Rural commons globally are facing environmental, demographic, and economic changes that challenge their sustainability. In addition, political and regulatory burdens can complicate the running of communal enterprises that provide income and livelihoods for community members, young and old. When these challenges combine with the cultural changes driven by globalization, youth in rural areas– especially those without access to land–may look outside of their communities for opportunities. The labor shortages and detachment from place that follow can undermine local capacities to manage communal lands for natural resource-based livelihoods. Researchers and NGOs that have studied and supported community-based resource management, including community forest enterprises (CFEs), argue that building community capacities and improving access to markets are necessary for forest commons to be sustainable. Yet, the role of young people in all of this remains understudied, including how their perceptions and motivations vis a vis forest livelihoods and work compare to those of older members who enjoy tenure rights and associated benefits. To help address this knowledge gap, we conducted semi-structured interviews with youth/young adults and older rights-holders in communities in different regions of Mexico with their own forestry enterprise, along with a small number of non-community members working in or supporting the country’s community forestry sector. We found that youth held a degree of attachment to traditional rural life, but perceived limited economic opportunities locally, low and unstable incomes, and few retirement benefits associated with forest work. This, along with the physical strain of land-based livelihoods, a lack of access to credit, processing delays for harvesting permits, and outdated logging equipment, contributed to diminished interest in the forestry sector and enhanced motivations to out-migrate. To cope with internal labor shortages, communities seek labor from afar, offering short-term contractual wages, and lease land and rights to outsiders. Such actions occur outside of federal commons law, suggesting that the regulatory context in Mexico is out of step with the emergent realities and needs of contemporary forest communities.
articles.abstract_cn: 全球农村公地正面临环境、人口和经济变化，这些变化对其可持续性构成挑战。此外，政治和监管负担可能使为社区成员（无论老少）提供收入和生计的社区企业的运营复杂化。当这些挑战与全球化驱动的文化变迁相结合时，农村地区的青年——尤其是那些无法获得土地的人——可能会在社区之外寻找机会。随之而来的劳动力短缺和对地方的疏离感可能削弱当地管理公有土地以维持基于自然资源的生计的能力。研究和支持社区资源管理（包括社区森林企业）的研究人员和非政府组织认为，建设社区能力和改善市场准入对于森林公地的可持续性至关重要。然而，年轻人在其中的作用仍未得到充分研究，包括他们对森林生计和工作的看法和动机与享有土地权利及相关福利的年长成员相比如何。为帮助填补这一知识空白，我们对墨西哥不同地区拥有自己林业企业的社区中的青年/年轻成年人和年长权利持有者进行了半结构化访谈，并采访了少数在该国社区林业部门工作或支持该部门的非社区成员。我们发现，青年对传统农村生活有一定程度的依恋，但认为当地经济机会有限，森林工作收入低且不稳定，退休福利少。这加上土地生计的体力消耗、缺乏信贷渠道、采伐许可审批延迟以及伐木设备过时，导致他们对林业部门的兴趣降低，并增强了向外迁移的动机。为应对内部劳动力短缺，社区从远处寻求劳动力，提供短期合同工资，并将土地和权利出租给外人。这些行为发生在联邦公地法律之外，表明墨西哥的监管环境与当代森林社区的新兴现实和需求脱节。

articles.title_en: Enhancing green infrastructure in cities: Urban car parks as an opportunity space
articles.title_cn: 增强城市绿色基础设施：城市停车场作为机会空间
articles.abstract_en: Interest in radical solutions to embedding Green Infrastructure (GI) into the built environment are at an all-time high. With land value often preventing more mundane forms of GI, key actors, such as planners, developers, architects and others, are increasingly exploring novel methods for embedding the features. This innovation involves a surge in green roofs, living walls and other systems which enables nature to thrive in otherwise hostile environments. Many of these systems are embedded on or within office complexes, universities and various ‘clean’ buildings within cities. However, there is a nascent movement to using urban car parks to enhance GI. In this opinion piece, we reflect on the opportunity space here and the potential to upscale work around embedding GI into urban car parks: exploring good practice, barriers to implementation and recommendations for moving the activity forward.
articles.abstract_cn: 对将绿色基础设施（GI）嵌入建筑环境的激进解决方案的兴趣正处于历史最高点。由于土地价值往往阻碍了更为普通的GI形式，规划者、开发商、建筑师等关键行动者正越来越多地探索嵌入这些特征的新方法。这一创新涉及绿色屋顶、活体墙和其他系统的激增，使自然能够在原本恶劣的环境中茁壮成长。许多此类系统嵌入或附着于办公楼群、大学以及城市中各种“清洁”建筑上。然而，利用城市停车场来增强GI的新兴运动正在兴起。在这篇观点文章中，我们反思了这里的机会空间以及围绕将GI嵌入城市停车场进行升级的潜力：探索良好实践、实施障碍以及推进该活动的建议。

articles.title_en: The economic impacts of green stormwater infrastructure: An evaluation of novel stormwater management policies in Washington, D.C
articles.title_cn: 绿色雨水基础设施的经济影响：华盛顿特区新型雨水管理政策的评估
articles.abstract_en: Increases in urban stormwater infrastructure needs have led cities around the world to turn towards nature-based ‘green’ stormwater infrastructure (GI). While GI can be an effective tool for addressing many urban flooding and water quality problems, many policymakers remain skeptical of GI due to concerns about financial uncertainties and performance risks. Moreover, cost-benefit analyses of changes to urban infrastructure policies often fail to consider the economic impacts – jobs created and value added to the regional economy – of infrastructure (traditional or GI) construction. Compounding this, few studies have modeled the economic impacts of GI. In this paper, we analyze the economic impacts arising from novel development regulations requiring GI to offset impervious cover expansion in Washington, D.C (USA). Using data from a survey of GI construction firms, we determine annual, direct GI investment, and construct an input-output model to estimate indirect and induced economic impacts at the regional scale. We find that, from 2015 to 2020, GI construction supported over $91 million in average annual economic output, ∼$45 million in labor income, ∼$60 million in value added, and created (or supported) 437 jobs in the DC metropolitan region. Sensitivity analysis around regulatory stringency (higher or lower stormwater retention requirements) reveals asymmetric economic impacts that increase more given higher retention requirements than they decrease for lower retention requirements. Our analytical approach can serve as a model to help other regions produce a more comprehensive accounting of the economic feasibility of green infrastructure for urban stormwater management.
articles.abstract_cn: 城市雨水基础设施需求的增加促使世界各地城市转向基于自然的“绿色”雨水基础设施（GI）。虽然GI可以成为解决许多城市洪水和水质问题的有效工具，但许多政策制定者由于对财务不确定性和性能风险的担忧，仍对GI持怀疑态度。此外，城市基础设施政策变化的成本效益分析往往未能考虑基础设施建设（传统或GI）的经济影响——创造的就业机会和对区域经济的附加值。加之，很少有研究对GI的经济影响进行建模。在本文中，我们分析了美国华盛顿特区要求GI抵消不透水面积扩张的新型开发法规所产生的经济影响。利用对GI建设企业的调查数据，我们确定了年度直接GI投资，并构建投入产出模型以估算区域范围内的间接和诱导经济影响。我们发现，从2015年到2020年，GI建设支持了年均超过91万美元的经济产出，约45万美元的劳动收入，约60万美元的附加值，并在华盛顿都市区创造（或支持）了437个就业岗位。围绕监管严格性（更高或更低的雨水滞留要求）的敏感性分析揭示了不对称的经济影响，即更高的滞留要求带来的增加大于更低滞留要求带来的减少。我们的分析方法可以作为模型，帮助其他地区更全面地核算绿色基础设施用于城市雨水管理的经济可行性。

articles.title_en: A multiple models-multiple users group GIS-based decision support system for land use problems
articles.title_cn: 面向土地利用问题的多模型-多用户群体GIS决策支持系统
articles.abstract_en: Group GIS-based Decision Support Systems (GGDSSs) have been used as effective tools to involve a particular group of individuals in the process of assessing alternative lands/locations for a particular use. Multiple Models-Multiple Users GGDSSs refer to the systems in which each decision maker may use a different decision model in the group assessment process. The variety and dynamic nature of individual decision models defined by decision makers raises the need for access to diverse sets of spatial data as well as GIS (Geographic Information System) and MCDA (Multicriteria Decision Analysis) functionalities. To overcome this problem, the study presents a Web service-based framework for Multiple Models-Multiple Users GGDSS using OGC (Open Geospatial Consortium) and XMCDA (XML-based Multicriteria Decision Analysis) standards. The usability assessment of the proposed GGDSS shows that majority of the users would like to use this system regularly (40 % strongly agree and 30 % agree), believe it is easy to use (35 % strongly agree and 35 % agree), state that the various functions in this system are well integrated (60 % strongly agree and 20 % agree), believe most people would learn to use it very quickly (60 % strongly agree and 20 % agree), and have a high level of confidence using the system (65 % strongly agree and 5 % agree).
articles.abstract_cn: 群体GIS决策支持系统（GGDSSs）已被用作有效工具，让特定群体参与评估特定用途的备选土地/地点。多模型-多用户GGDSSs指的是在群体评估过程中，每个决策者可能使用不同决策模型的系统。决策者所定义的个体决策模型的多样性和动态性，引发了对多样化空间数据集以及GIS（地理信息系统）和MCDA（多准则决策分析）功能的需求。为解决这一问题，本研究提出了一个基于Web服务的多模型-多用户GGDSS框架，采用OGC（开放地理空间联盟）和XMCDA（基于XML的多准则决策分析）标准。对所提出的GGDSS的可用性评估显示，大多数用户愿意定期使用该系统（40%强烈同意和30%同意），认为其易于使用（35%强烈同意和35%同意），表示该系统的各种功能整合良好（60%强烈同意和20%同意），相信大多数人会很快学会使用（60%强烈同意和20%同意），并且对使用该系统有很高的信心（65%强烈同意和5%同意）。
